source_inspections.note: Reuters, October 8, 2026: Chief Justice John Roberts issued an administrative stay pausing the Fourth Circuit deadline that required the FCC to act on a challenge to its political-advertising rate policy by Friday. The response is due Saturday; the temporary stay is not a merits ruling.

Supreme Court docket 26A274 and emergency application metadata identify the FCC political-advertising dispute, parties, lower-court proceeding and application history. The October 8 administrative-stay action was confirmed in the independently inspected Reuters report, not inferred from an inaccessible order text.

Associated Press, October 8, 2026: FEMA informed states that it was rescinding election-related requirements from the Homeland Security Grant Program after a federal district court ruled the conditions unlawful. The program distributes about $1 billion; the rescission implements the immediate policy retreat while litigation can continue.

Associated Press, October 8, 2026: Acting Army Secretary Michael Obadal set Nidal Hasan's execution for December 3 at Fort Hood, and the Pentagon said Thursday that the execution would be livestreamed. The report notes Hasan can pursue habeas relief and the date may change.
